 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE DR. ANSHUMAN  ORAL ORDER 2 15-09-2023 Learned counsel for the petitioner and counsel for the State are present.
2. Counsel for the petitioner is directed to serve the copy of the writ petition upon the counsel for the NTPC.

3. Counsel for the State is directed to file a brief counter-affidavit about the applicability and non-applicability of the new law based on RFCTLARR (Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement) Act, 2013 as well as the Circulars issued by the Revenue and Land Reforms Department, Government of Bihar.
